note: Organization Usage API totals can overlap API-key clients. Each accounts entry binds a display account_alias to an explicit stable, non-secret organization_scope supplied as OPENAI_ORGANIZATION_SCOPE. Reusing a display alias across scopes is allowed because receipts use a scope fingerprint. Decisions require dated human scope evidence; subscription Codex is not presumed overlapping.

modes.unset: Quarantine the full organization total in scratch/reconcile/. Equal aggregates do not establish overlap.
modes.additive: Human evidence establishes this organization's usage is outside every counted client scope. Write to scratch/receipts/.
modes.overlapping: Human evidence establishes overlap. Keep the full organization total quarantined without partial subtraction.
